Each drive has its own eligibility, documents and venue, listed below.

Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 – full job details

The Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 page now tracks three walk-ins that run on the same three days. Two are in Hyderabad and one is in Pune, and they hire for different work: blended customer support, non-voice international customer service, and digital map editing.

You can attend only the drive that matches your city and qualification. Recruiters at each venue check documents on the spot, so read the eligibility and not-eligible lists for your drive before you travel. None of the three drives mentions an online test or registration fee.

Drive Role & ID Date & time Venue Eligibility
A – Hyderabad Customer Support (Email, Chat & Voice) | Naukri 231126025048 25–27 Nov, 10:30 AM–1:00 PM Wipro Gopanpally Campus, Kanchi–Gachibowli Road Any UG/PG, 0–3 yrs; pursuing not eligible
B – Pune Associate – Non-Voice, International Customer Service (Process Associate) | Req 219833 25–27 Nov, 11:00 AM–12:30 PM Wipro Unit 2, Plot 31, Hinjewadi Phase 2 HSC or graduates; freshers & experienced; B.Tech/BCA/MCA/MBA and others excluded
C – Hyderabad Associate Analyst (Digital Mapping) / Production Agent L1 | Req 220088 25–27 Nov, 10:00 AM–12:00 PM Wipro Gachibowli Campus, Gate No. 1 (Vendor Gate) Any graduate fresher; full-time students not eligible

Drive A: Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 for Customer Support, Gopanpally

Drive A of the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 is a customer support process that handles buyer and seller tickets for an online marketplace client. Wipro wants 50 associates, and both freshers and people with up to three years of support experience can attend. Naukri lists it as a full-time, permanent Customer Success Associate job under BPM / BPO.

  • Dates: Wednesday 25 Nov to Friday 27 Nov 2026
  • Reporting time: 10:30 AM to 1:00 PM
  • Venue: Wipro Gopanpally Campus, Kanchi–Gachibowli Road, Journalist Colony Phase 3, Hyderabad
  • Contact person: not stated in the listing

Hard filters (Drive A): Pursuing graduates or postgraduates are not eligible. Provisional Certificate (PC) and Consolidated Marks Memo (CMM) are mandatory. The job is work from office in Gopanpally with rotational shifts, night shifts included, and Wipro wants immediate joiners.

Title vs description: The headline says “Customer Support”, but the description is titled Email & Chat Support and also asks for voice experience. Expect mostly written support with some calls.

Documents for Drive A of the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026: updated resume, a passport-size photo taken in the last six months, Voter ID and PAN card, copies of graduation documents including PC and CMM, and experience letters if you have worked before. Experienced candidates should carry proof of earlier email, chat or voice support work.

Drive B: Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 for Non-Voice International Customer Service, Pune

Drive B of the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 is for the role Associate – Non-Voice Process, International Customer Service, Band AA, based in Pune. On careers.wipro.com the same requisition (219833, posted 21 Nov) is titled Process Associate. Freshers and experienced candidates are both welcome.

  • Dates: Wednesday 25 Nov to Friday 27 Nov 2026
  • Reporting time: 11:00 AM to 12:30 PM
  • Venue: Wipro, Unit 2, Plot No. 31, Hinjewadi Phase 2, Rajiv Gandhi Info Tech Park, Pune, Maharashtra 411057
  • Entry: only the first 100 applicants each day are seen, first come first served

Eligibility for the Pune leg of the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026: HSC pass or graduates with excellent spoken and written English, basic computer skills and a customer-service attitude. You must be fine with US or rotational shifts, rotational week-offs and working from the office.

Not eligible for Drive B: B.Tech, Diploma (Technical), BCA, MCA, M.Tech, MBA, B.Ed., BA LLB or equivalent professional qualifications; full-time students; and anyone living outside Wipro’s approved transport boundary (cab is one-side only).

Check on the day: The official Wipro page for 219833 also lists typing of 30 WPM at 90% accuracy, 24/7 shifts, a B.Sc IT exclusion and Claims Processing as the mandatory skill, while the recruiter flyer calls it International Customer Service. Ask which process you are being hired for.

Documents for Drive B: an original government photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID or Passport) and your updated resume. Key skills tested are written and verbal English, customer service, problem-solving and listening.

Drive C: Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 for Digital Mapping, Gachibowli

Drive C of the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 hires Associate Analysts for digital mapping operations, Band AA, in Hyderabad. The careers.wipro.com page for requisition 220088 (posted 20 Nov) uses the title Production Agent L1 and lists Geographic Information Systems (Maps) as the mandatory skill. It is a fresher role open to any graduate.

  • Dates: Wednesday 25 Nov to Friday 27 Nov 2026
  • Reporting time: 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM
  • Venue: Wipro Campus – Gachibowli, Wipro Gate No. 1 (Vendor Gate), Nanakramguda Road, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana 500032
  • Schedule: 5 days a week, 2 days off, rotational shifts, work from office

Skills for the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 mapping slot (Drive C): digital mapping operations, map features and workflows, geospatial data annotation and mapping tools, plus excellent English, basic knowledge of online and offline maps, and analytical and logical reasoning. Immediate joiners are preferred.

Not eligible for Drive C: full-time students. Only graduates can attend.

Documents for Drive C: updated resume, a passport-size photo, your original PAN card and a copy of the provisional certificate of your highest qualification.

What you will do in the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 roles

  • Drive A: answer buyer and seller questions over email, chat and some calls; fix order, listing and payment issues; flag fraud risks; keep case notes and meet SLA targets
  • Drive B: handle international customers in writing (non-voice), log every query, follow set procedures and escalate unresolved cases to the team leader
  • Drive C: edit and check map features, annotate geospatial data, follow mapping workflows and keep quality and accuracy targets

Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 eligibility

In short, under the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026, Drive A takes any graduate or postgraduate with 0–3 years of experience, Drive B takes HSC holders and non-technical graduates, and Drive C takes graduate freshers. All three are office-based with rotational shifts.

Not confirmed: none of the three listings states a passing-year batch, minimum percentage or age limit. Treat any batch claim on social media as unverified until the recruiter confirms it.

Expected salary for the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026

Only Drive A has an official figure: Naukri shows ₹2.75–3.5 lakh per annum, and AmbitionBox reports about ₹1.4–4 LPA for Wipro Customer Support Associates (62 salaries, all-India). Drives B and C do not disclose pay.

Reported figures for the other two Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 roles: AmbitionBox shows ₹2.6–2.9 LPA for Wipro Process Associates in Pune (135 salaries, 0–4 years) and ₹2.4–2.6 LPA for Wipro Mapping Analysts in Hyderabad (334 salaries, 0–3 years). These are market benchmarks, not Wipro’s offer, so ask for the CTC break-up in writing.

Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 selection process

The Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 interview rounds are not published for any venue. Based on similar Wipro walk-ins, plan for these stages:

  1. Registration and document check at the gate
  2. HR screening on communication and shift readiness
  3. A short test: an email or chat reply exercise for A and B, a typing or map-reading task for C (typical, not confirmed)
  4. Operations round with process and scenario questions
  5. Offer discussion and joining formalities

Documents required for the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026

  • An updated resume for every drive (build one quickly with our Resume Builder)
  • Drive A: recent photo, Voter ID, PAN, graduation copies with PC and CMM
  • Drive B: original government photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID or Passport)
  • Drive C: passport-size photo, original PAN, copy of provisional certificate

Preparation tips for the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026

  • Practise short, polite written replies to upset customers (Drives A and B)
  • Open Google Maps and OpenStreetMap and learn how roads, places and addresses are marked (Drive C)
  • Prepare a one-minute answer using our self-introduction for interview guide
  • Check your typing speed and resume with the free Freshershunt tools
  • Reach early; walk-in queues build fast, and Pune admits only the first 100

How to apply for the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026

For Drive A, click I am interested on the official Naukri listing. For Drive B and Drive C, open the official Wipro pages for Process Associate 219833 and Production Agent L1 220088, then walk in at your drive’s time with printed documents.

Fraud warning: Wipro does not charge any fee for interviews or offer letters. Ignore anyone asking for money to “confirm” a slot in the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026.

More openings: see other walk-in interviews in Hyderabad, the Wipro Off Campus Drive 2027 post, and our list of companies hiring freshers.

About Wipro

Wipro Limited is a Bengaluru-headquartered IT and business process services company with operations in more than 60 countries. Its Hyderabad and Pune campuses run large customer experience and mapping operations for global clients and hire graduates through walk-in drives such as the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026. Read more on the official Wipro website.

Frequently asked questions

What is the salary in the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026?

Drive A (Customer Support, Hyderabad) states ₹2.75–3.5 LPA on Naukri. Drives B and C do not disclose pay; AmbitionBox reports ₹2.6–2.9 LPA for Wipro Process Associates in Pune and ₹2.4–2.6 LPA for Wipro Mapping Analysts in Hyderabad.

Who is eligible for the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026?

Drive A: any UG or PG with 0–3 years, pursuing not eligible. Drive B: HSC or graduates with excellent English, but B.Tech, technical diploma, BCA, MCA, M.Tech, MBA, B.Ed. and BA LLB holders are excluded. Drive C: graduate freshers. No batch year is stated.

Is the Pune Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 slot voice or non-voice?

The Pune drive is a non-voice International Customer Service process with US or rotational shifts. The official Wipro page also mentions typing at 30 WPM and claims processing, so confirm the process on the day.

Where are the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026 venues and timings?

Drive A: Wipro Gopanpally Campus, Hyderabad, 10:30 AM–1:00 PM. Drive B: Unit 2, Plot 31, Hinjewadi Phase 2, Pune 411057, 11:00 AM–12:30 PM. Drive C: Wipro Gachibowli Gate No. 1 (Vendor Gate), Nanakramguda Road, Hyderabad 500032, 10:00 AM–12:00 PM. All run 25–27 November 2026.

How do I apply for the Wipro Walk in Drive 2026?

Mark interest on Naukri for Drive A or open the careers.wipro.com page for Drive B (219833) or Drive C (220088), then walk in on any drive day with your resume and the documents listed for that drive.
